title: AKB tenant stats snapshot, version 1
description: Owned by akb-oss. Consumers vendor this file at a pinned version. Every numeric field is nullable and optional on purpose: a value that could not be measured is OMITTED from the payload (null is accepted for the same meaning), never defaulted to 0. Decode into a nullable type; a plain integer will turn both encodings into a measured zero.

schema_version.description: Reject the whole snapshot on an unrecognised version rather than reading the fields you recognise.

computed_at.description: When this snapshot was assembled. Advances once per sampler interval; a value that stops moving means sampling is failing while the last good snapshot is still being served.

storage.description: Physical and logical storage. Carries its own watermark because physical sizes are collector-maintained approximations with no relationship to the corpus transaction snapshot.

observed_at.description: When the storage figures were read.

db_bytes.description: Physical size of the whole tenant database.

vector_bytes.description: Physical bytes of the pgvector derived index (relations plus their indexes and TOAST). A SUBSET of db_bytes when present — never add the two. Absent when the vector index is not inside this database (a non-pgvector driver, or pgvector on its own DSN).

file_bytes.description: Live logical bytes of confirmed vault files. Absent when any confirmed file has no recorded size, because a partial sum reads as a total.

file_count.description: Live confirmed vault files, standalone files and editor attachments alike.

corpus.description: Live inventory counts from one repeatable-read snapshot, so subset relationships between them always hold. Live means not deleted; archived vaults and documents are counted.

distilled_doc_count.description: Documents produced by distillation; a subset of doc_count. Absent while the criterion for 'distilled' is undetermined in akb-oss.

vector_chunk_count.description: Chunks present in the vector index. Chunks awaiting indexing are not counted; that backlog is reported by /health.

activity.description: Call volume over one CLOSED UTC day. The window is finalized once and never recomputed, so a consumer may keep the first value it sees. The whole section is absent until a day has been finalized.

window_start.description: Inclusive start of the window (midnight UTC).

window_end.description: Exclusive end of the window (the following midnight UTC).

calls_read.description: Read-classified tool calls in the window. Absent when the window closed with call volume unmeasurable — a different fact from zero calls, and permanent, since the window is never recomputed.

calls_write.description: Write-classified tool calls in the window.

active_actors.description: Distinct identified actors in the window. Calls with no authenticated actor are counted in the call totals but are not a distinct someone.
